form.typeHint: The type picks the colour and the icon: notice is muted, season is the accent, maintenance the warning colour, incident the danger colour.
form.textPlaceholder: Nuptial Flight closes on 29 Sep. Submissions after the close enter the next season.
form.linkHint: A site path starting with /, or an https:// address. The bar shows it as “More →”.
form.stickyHint: On: it draws until you disable it, with no close.
form.dismissableHint: Off: a reader can close it, and that browser remembers.
form.endsAtHint: In your local time. After it, the bar drops the announcement on its own.
form.previewEmpty: The text you type shows here, as the bar draws it.
